comments.text: I had no idea Dominica was this incredible! 🇩🇲🌿 The Boiling Lake, volcanic landscapes, endless rivers, and beautiful wildlife make this island feel like a hidden world. Definitely one of the most fascinating places in the Caribbean. Would love to visit someday! ❤🌎
